headline: BILLS Too HIGH 😤 Energy UK Demands MORE Aid ⚡💸
text:
ENERGY 🏛️ UK ⚡ SAYS 🗣️ the CURRENT 📅 SUPPORT 🛟 for HOUSEHOLDS 🏡 most in NEED 🆘 does NOT 🚫 go 🏃 FAR 📏 ENOUGH 📏 with these HIGHER ⬆️ energy ⚡ BILLS 💸 this WINTER ❄️ so the GOVERNMENT 🏛️ must STEP 🦶 IN 🛬 to PROVIDE 🤲 more HELP 👐 for those HOUSEHOLDS 🏡 most in NEED 🆘 the BODY 🏢 representing energy FIRMS 🏭 has SAID 🗣️ that STUBBORNLY 🐂 high 🏔️ PRICES 💰 over the last few YEARS 📅 have left some PEOPLE 👥 needing EMERGENCY 🚨 SUPPORT 🛟 over and ABOVE ☝️ the existing £150 WARM 🥵 HOME 🏠 DISCOUNT 🏷️ Energy UK said 🗣️ and these prices have been POUNDING 💥 them so HARD 🪨 they need that extra THICK 🍆 AID 💦 to SURVIVE 🛟 this is PEAK ⛰️ down bad 🥴 energy crisis 🔥💯!!

OFFICIALS 🧑‍💼 say 🤫 a 🔥 BETTER 🎯 TARGETED 🏹 support 🛟 SCHEME 📋 that 🖕 takes 👏 into 📥 ACCOUNT 📊 someone's 👤 INCOME 💵 HEALTH 🩹 and ENERGY ⚡ CUMSUMPTION 🥵 was NEEDED 🥺 it ADDED 😤 after 🕒 seeing 👀 the numbers 📉!! On 📅 WEDNESDAY 📅 the energy ⚡ PRICE 🏷️ CAP 🧢 for OCTOBER 🍂 onwards 🚀 will be ANNOUNCED 📢 by regulator 📏 Ofgem 🏛️ and is EXPECTED 🧐 to hit 🎯 a THREE 3️⃣ YEAR 🗓️ HIGH 🏔️💦 that will have UK 🇬🇧 citizens 👥 down BAD 😩 begging 🥺 for more ➕ AID 💸 as the bills 📜 hit insane levels 🥵 this is PURE 🔥 chaos 😵‍💫 and the only thing getting CONSUMED 🥜 is our SANITY 🧠 fr fr 💯!!

the GOVERNMENT 🏛️ spokesperson 🗣️ just 📣 ANNOUNCED 📢 they're slashing 🔪 VAT 📉 on those electricity ⚡ BILLS 📜 in addition to the WARM 🥵 HOMES 🏠 DISCOUNT 🏷️ and will do everything 👐 we can 🛡️ to SHIELD 🛡️ CUMsumers 👥 from global 🌍 ENERGY ⚡ SHOCKS 🫨!! Energy UK chief 🧑‍💼 Dhara Vyas said suppliers 🔌 continue 🔄 to do all 💪 they can to help 🤝 their customers 🛍️ but as well as persistently 📈 high 🏔️ BILLS 💸 record levels of DEBT 💳 show how the current 🕒 SYSTEM ⚙️ is FAILING 🥀 to provide the right ✅ SUPPORT 🫂 to those in NEED 🆘!! A new SOCIAL 👥 DISCOUNT 🏷️ scheme would result in a system 🏗️ that WORKS 🛠️ BETTER 📈 for everyone 🌍 she added 🗣️ and one sweaty 😓 staffer 🧑‍💼 admitted it left them all THOROUGHLY 🥵 STROKED 🖐️ and ready for that sweet RELIEF 💦 fr fr 💯!!

ENERGY ⚡ UK 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 says 🗣️ suppliers 🛍️ have a full RANGE 📏 of SUPPORT 🛟 measures 📜 for CUSTOMERS 🛒 that INCLUDES 📦 DEBT 💳 WRITE 📝 OFF 🗑️ schemes 🗺️ and HARDSHIP 🥺 funds 🏦 as well as ENHANCED ⚡ FUNDING 💰 to CHARITY ❤️ partners 👫 but SCORER 🥇 DADDY 🍆 Adam Scorer 🧑‍💼 chief 🏆 at NEA 🏢 is not having it 🛑 saying 'Heading toward winter ❄️ with prices 📈 spiking 🔥 again we expect suppliers to do more ➕ listen 👂 and respond 📣 to their customer who are really struggling 😩 More than anything else people need a responsible 🤲 and CUMpathetic 💦 approach to debt' he added 😤 this whole thing is giving us MAJOR 🥵 'do it HARDER 🪨 daddy' 🧔 vibes with those bills 📉 too HIGH 😤 and suppliers not PUMPING 💦 out enough RELIEF 🥺 no cap fr!!

OFGEM 🏛️ REPORTED 📢 at the END 🏁 of last WINTER ❄️ that customers 👥 who had FALLEN 🍂 behind 🛤️ on their ENERGY ⚡ BILLS 💸 owed suppliers 🏪 a RECORD 🏆 £4.7bn 💰!! Since then wholesale 🛒 energy ⚡ prices 💲 have RISEN 📈 following the START 🔥 of the IRAN 🇮🇷 WAR ⚔️ in February 📅. Cornwall 🌾 Insight 🔎 preDICKts 🍆 that Ofgem's CAP 🧢 on household 🏠 price rises 📈 which is set every three months 📅 will go UP ⬆️ by 4% when it is announced 📣 on Wednesday 📆. The rise 📈 will apply to household 🏡 bills 💸 during the first half ✂️ of the coming winter ❄️ and follows a sharper 🔪 13% rise 📈 in July 🌡️. The energy ⚡ cap 🧢 covers around 33 million households 🏘️ in England 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Wales 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 and Scotland 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 getting POUNDED 💦💦 like this fr fr!!

PRICE 📈 RISE 🆙 would OUTWEIGH ⚖️ the IMPACT 🥊 of Prime Minister Andy Burnham's MOVE 🚶 to REMOVE ✂️ VAT on HOUSEHOLD 🏘️ ELECTRICITY ⚡ BILLS 📜!! The WARM 🥵 HOME 🏠 DISCOUNT 🏷️ reached SIX 6️⃣ MILLION 👥 customers but there were ANOTHER 2.5 MILLION 🥺 who NEEDED HELP 🛟 because a MEDICAL 🏥 CONDITION or DRAUGHTY 🌀 HOME 🏡 meant they CONSUMED 🥄 more ENERGY ⚡!! ENERGY 🏬 UK said its PROPOSED 📝 NEW 🆕 SCHEME 📑 would COST 💸 £1.9bn nearly DOUBLE 2️⃣ the current scheme but could OFFER 🎁 £450 in SUPPORT 🫂 to some HOUSEHOLDS 🏘️!! Scorer Daddy 🍆 from the NEA said this was the sort of approach his CHARITY ❤️ was calling for especially as the Warm Home Discount has RISEN ⬆️ by only £10 over the last DECADE 🕰️ leaving us all DOWN BAD 😩 for some real RELIEF 🥵💦!!
